entities.name: Tingler
entities.description: Phyrexian centipede-like device that zombifies enemy troops by replacing the spinal cord.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders of Dominaria who used Tinglers.

events.summary: Tinglers crawl into victims' mouths, rip out the spinal cord and replace it to control the body.
events.quote: The Tingler zombifies its victims by crawling into the mouth

relations.quote: was a nasty little device used by the Phyrexians during their invasion of Dominaria
